CustomField.description: Red marker when the vehicle the customer wants has no cars available, so the rep requests an import.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Vehicle_Model_Of_Interest__c)), NOT(IsConverted), Vehicle_Model_Of_Interest__r.Available_Stock__c = 0), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", "Out of stock") & " Out of stock - request an import", "" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows a red flag when no car of this model is available.
CustomField.label: Stock Alert
